newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian soldier's mother pleads for mercy.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian soldier's mother pleads for mercy.

text.p: A Jordanian woman who said she was the mother of a border soldier who killed seven Israeli schoolchildren on Thursday begged King Hussein of Jordan to have mercy on her son.
The woman told reporters who visited her in northwest Jordan close by the border with Israel that her son, Ahmed Moussa, was insane.
"For God's sake, King Hussein stand by my son," Umm Qassem said. "He has a mental illness. Have mercy on Ahmed."
Jordan said the gunman had been arrested and "will be prosecuted to the full extent of the law," but officials have given no details of their investigations.
Umm Qassem, wearing a traditional head-dress and wailing in grief, said her son had accumulated heavy debts.
King Hussein said on Thursday he felt a deep sense of shame that the "very vile crime" had been committed against children in Jordan.
